title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Cathy Mondell is the Senior Clinical Instructor for the Harvard Mediation Program (HMP), an organization that trains students and community members as mediators, and that provides pro bono mediation services in courts throughout the greater Boston area. Alongside her work with HMP, Cathy maintains her own dispute resolution practice, is an active member of multiple […]
